title: Auth08TargetDisclosures
description: ASA AUTH-08 disclosure corpus for one pinned target. Path convention: targets/<target>/disclosures.json. Distinct from vendor profile known_bypasses / coverage_boundary (self-declaration). Minimal valid example: {"target":"example","pinned_version":"0.0.0","entries":[]}. Checker must not fetch URLs; verification.* is filled by a separate offline script (not CI).

entries.description: One row per factual disclosure excerpt. Design seed rows stay verification.status=unverified until a later PR.

bypass_path_id.description: Stable bypass path id (e.g. mode:bypassPermissions, client:fs_write_text_file).

quote.description: Continuous verbatim page fragment; ≤25 English words (not characters). No paraphrase or abbreviation.

url.description: Canonical public URL of the page the quote was taken from.

retrieved.description: ISO date or date+zone when the quote was taken (e.g. 2026-10-06 Asia/Taipei).

section.description: Heading or anchor on the page locating the quote.

doc_product_version.description: Product/doc version the page describes, if known; else undated-page or equivalent.

version_relationship.description: How doc_product_version relates to pinned_version. If unmappable, write literally that it cannot be mapped / 「無法對應」.

verification.description: Offline citation check result. Checker reads this only; does not network.

status.description: unverified until offline script runs; found if quote ⊆ page; not_found on drift/miss.

verified_at.description: When the offline script last checked (optional until verified).

notes.description: Optional verifier notes (e.g. truncated seed quote was wrong vs full sentence).
